topic: Power of attorney done early vs done never (Mark vs Iris)

scenes.narration: Banks freeze parents accounts six months without power of attorney. Court is in session!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera at the bench holding up a frozen bank account icon, comic burst banner reads EIGHTY THOUSAND FROZEN, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Mark and Iris each have a healthy parent in their late seventies.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man mark and woman iris each visiting an aging parent in matching tidy living rooms, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Each parent has eighty thousand in checking and monthly bills.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, close up of two coffee tables with banking statements reading EIGHTY THOUSAND beside stacks of monthly bills, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Mark says they will set up the power of attorney later.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, mark waving off a brochure labeled DURABLE POWER OF ATTORNEY in his father's living room, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He thinks his dad is healthy and there is no rush.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, mark relaxing with his father on a couch, the brochure tossed in a drawer behind them, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Iris drives her mother to an attorney and pays two hundred dollars.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, iris and her mother walking into an attorney's office, a fee paper reading TWO HUNDRED visible on the desk, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: They sign a durable power of attorney that same month.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, iris and her mother both signing a printed POWER OF ATTORNEY form at an attorney's desk, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Six months later Mark's father has a serious stroke overnight.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, mark rushing into a hospital room, his father in a bed with monitors, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The bank freezes the account and Mark hires a lawyer.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, shocked mark at a bank counter being told the account is frozen, a teller pointing at a paper stamped FROZEN, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He spends six months in probate court paying lawyers for access.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, mark in a courthouse hallway with a lawyer, a calendar flipping six months, comic banner reads LAWYER FEES, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Iris pays mom's bills the same day she gets sick.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, iris paying bills online from her mother's bedside, a calm green check mark on her phone, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Sign a power of attorney while parents are healthy. Court dismissed!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera banging her gavel, holding up a POWER OF ATTORNEY form stamped SIGNED, comic banner reads DO IT EARLY, kids comic book illustration
